scope: One identity-masked full-sentence comparison under an explicitly provisional selected Hebrew source; not adjudication of historical source priority.
source_text: בהנחל עליון גוים בהפרידו בני אדם יצב גבלת עמים למספר בני אלוהים׃
interpretation: Unchanged units follow the base vocalization: Hiphil infinitives of inherit and separate, Hiphil setting of boundaries; final unit is sons of God. No decision whether Most High and Yahweh are distinct beings; no numerical headcount supplied.
close_gloss: At the Most High's causing nations to inherit, at his separating sons of humankind, he set boundaries of peoples according to the number of sons of God.
context_before: Remember the days of old; consider the years of generation after generation. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will say to you.
context_after: For Yahweh's portion is his people, Jacob the share of his inheritance.

candidates.M: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated humankind, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the divine beings.
candidates.T: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of man, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
candidates.R: When the Most High apportioned the nations, when he divided humankind, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.

policy.priority: Meaning and unsupported additions first, then ambiguity, source wording patterns, literary function, naturalness and consistency.
policy.audience: Literate modern English reader; readable wording serves fidelity, not familiarity alone.
policy.gender: No automatic masculine-form mandate. Adam may be man/humankind by context. Compare the repeated sons construction and explain any loss in notes.
policy.theology: Neither suppress divine imagery nor insert a settled pantheon, biological parentage, or relation between Most High and Yahweh.
policy.alternatives: Tie, HOLD or a minimally revised synthesis is permitted with reasons; no obligation to prefer novelty.

rubric: Inheritance wording and any ambiguity lost
Parallel בני אדם / בני אלוהים and referent clarity
Readability and notes needed to retain nuance
requested_result: Assess all three in paragraph context; select a defensible preference or HOLD, give its strongest objection, and check reversed presentation order. If synthesis is better, supply the exact complete sentence and reasons. Do not invent fresh lexicon consultation or truth probabilities.
